title: Unit and integration tests
summary: A unit test checks a small part. An integration test checks parts working together. Each finds different mistakes.
introduction: A unit test checks a small part. An integration test checks parts working together. Each finds different mistakes. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A unit test checks a small part. An integration test checks parts working together. Each finds different mistakes.

blocks.code:
Unit: price(2, 3) returns 6
Integration: basket passes its items to the price calculator
End-to-end: a learner adds an item and sees the total
blocks.title: Unit and integration tests

blocks.text: The tests grow from one calculation to a whole visible journey.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Classify a test that checks a form sends values to its validator.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not replace every small test with a slow whole-app test.
For more detail later, use this [Software Testing further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Testing).
